name: Cambio Uruguay Public API
description:
Free, read-only, public REST API behind https://cambio-uruguay.com.

It aggregates buy/sell quotes from 38+ Uruguayan exchange houses and banks (BROU, BCU and private *cambios*), refreshed about every 10 minutes, plus branch locations, historical series and AI market insights.

No API key or authentication is required; an optional free key (https://cambio-uruguay.com/empresas) identifies you, meters your usage and applies your plan. Please be considerate with request volume and cache responses where you can.

- Source code (open source): https://github.com/eduair94/cambio-uruguay
- MCP server: https://mcp.cambio-uruguay.com/mcp
- This document: https://cambio-uruguay.com/openapi.json
